# hg grafana

**What this page tells you:** every `hg grafana` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

Prove the promised grafana panels exist.

## Synopsis

```text
hg grafana prove
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## Description

Reads the panel routes as a real viewer would, and asks Grafana (as admin, deliberately) whether each promised panel EXISTS — a question about the dashboard, not about what any particular human may see. The RBAC half is `hg auth prove`.

## `hg grafana prove`

```text
hg grafana prove
```

Panel-existence proof against the local exposure.
